preMatch.sceneSetter: France and Senegal step into a Korea/Japan World Cup night in Seoul, with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: The World Cup opens in Asia for the first time. Thirty-two nations have arrived across Korea Republic and Japan, and the tournament begins beneath the lights of Seoul.
preMatch.inTheTournament: Nothing has happened yet. Thirty-two teams begin level across eight groups, and every prediction is still only a prediction.
preMatch.whyItMatters: Defending champions France open the tournament against debutants Senegal. The first night of Asia’s World Cup carries the weight of expectation and the unknown.

postMatch.matchReport: On the opening night in Seoul, Papa Bouba Diop scored the only goal as Senegal defeated defending champions France 1–0. The result announced both a debutant and a tournament that would refuse to follow the script.

keyMoments.title: Papa Bouba Diop found the net for Senegal

playersWhoShapedTheMatch.description: Scored at 30′ and shaped France 0–1 Senegal.
Steadied Senegal through a demanding World Cup night against France.

preMatch.whyItMatters: Host nation Korea Republic face Italy in a Round of 16 match that already feels larger than a single knockout night.

preMatch.sceneSetter: Germany and Brazil walk into Yokohama on the last night of the tournament, with the World Cup waiting under the lights.
